name: clax
description: Local artifacts with comment-driven development: publish HTML pages, view them, and get feedback back

interface.shortDescription: Publish and preview HTML artifacts locally
interface.longDescription: Clax runs a local server that hosts HTML pages published by agents. Publish pages, small apps, dashboards, and reports from Codex, open them in a browser, and publish new versions as the work changes. Every publish is kept as a numbered version.
defaultPrompt: Publish this page as an artifact and open it
